description: This source file defines an Android activity named `CardFlipActivity` which demonstrates a card-flip animation using fragment transactions with custom animations. It manages front and back fragments of a card, handles UI interactions such as flipping the card, and updates the action bar based on the current state.

classes.name: CardFlipActivity
classes.description: Main activity handling the card flip animation demonstrating front and back fragments with custom animations and navigation logic.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up the front fragment if no saved state exists, and registers back stack listener.

methods.name: onCreateOptionsMenu
methods.description: Creates the action bar menu with a dynamic flip button.

methods.name: onOptionsItemSelected
methods.description: Handles action bar item selections, including navigating up and flipping the card.

methods.name: flipCard
methods.description: Performs the flip animation by replacing fragments with custom animations and manages back stack.

methods.name: onBackStackChanged
methods.description: Updates UI state when the fragment back stack changes.

classes.name: CardFrontFragment
classes.description: Fragment representing the front side of the card.

classes.name: CardBackFragment
classes.description: Fragment representing the back side of the card.
